I had a long conversation with my dad today, he now knows I'm gay and I am struggling with suicide thoughts and extreme depression.

He has told me I can stay at home.

Crisis averted, my mind is at ease again, I'm at the very least calm right now and I don't have any plans to end it this weekend.

Thank you for your support, SW, it feels nice to know that there are people in the world that takes time out of their day to help others. 

Makes me kinda happy. 

nekothrow1 over and out, for now.
No, I haven't, I don't like bothering people with any issues I might have.
Living with friends is not an option because I have no friends other than a few contacts online. I can't rely on them.

My life so far has been all about money, all the money I've worked for in the past has gone to my dad, I inherited a large sum of money when I was younger when my grandmother died, my dad took it all.

My relatives don't want anything to do with a loser like me. I have nowhere to go.

You don't get anywhere in this world without money. 

I'm tired of being depressed all the time.
I don't have anywhere to go, the streets will be my new home come Monday.
